instruction.text: Find the phrase that uses repetition in the second paragraph.

feedback.end: Repetition can link paragraphs together by making it clear that both paragraphs are about the same thing. In this example, both of the paragraphs are about things zebras can do.

atoms.b:
Zebras can run up to 65 mph and maintain this speed for a considerable amount of time.

((Zebras can also)) somewhat avoid being detected by predators because of their stipes, which act as camouflage.

instruction.text: Find the phrase that uses repetition in the second paragraph.

atoms.b:
Yesterday, I travelled to visit my grandparents. They live in a bungalow in a small village in West Wales.

I live in Manchester, so ((travelling to visit my grandparents)) takes a long time.

instruction.text: Find the phrase that uses repetition in the second paragraph.

atoms.b:
It is very difficult to make Bakewell tarts. The pastry is very delicate, which makes it tricky to fill with marzipan.

Even though ((it is difficult to make Bakewell tarts)), my brother is going to try and make some for our sister’s birthday.

instruction.text: Choose the matching sentence to form the most cohesive paragraph using repetition.

atoms.a: Marie’s mum had warned the group of friends not to stay out too late and to avoid the dark of night.
atoms.b: As the evening progressed, the darkness did indeed creep in, leaving them stranded in the pitch black.

atoms.a: The café was very noisy. There were lots of people talking over the sound of the coffee machine.
atoms.b: Because of the noise, Luna found it difficult to hear what Ramsha was saying.

instruction.text: Choose the matching sentence to form the most cohesive paragraph using repetition.

atoms.a: In the early morning, the park is so silent that you can hear the birds chirping in the trees.
atoms.b: Ellie enjoys running at this time of day as the silence allows her to clear her thoughts.

atoms.a: The train arrived 80 minutes late on Saturday. I was dependent on it to meet my friends.
atoms.b: I arrived at the café over 80 minutes later than I was supposed to, but luckily my friends were very understanding.

instruction.text: Choose the matching sentence to form the most cohesive paragraph using repetition.

atoms.a: Sarah finds working in a café very stressful because it is difficult to use the coffee machine.
atoms.b: She is looking for a new job that doesn’t involve operating a machine of any kind.

atoms.a: I travelled by bus to meet my mum on Sunday. The bus arrived earlier than I had expected.
atoms.b: As I arrived in town so early, I sat in a café to wait for my mum to arrive.
